dedupe_keys.name: sensor based water quality parameter measurements across three pilot sites in coimbra

description: The researchers provide three independent raw sensor datasets for separate pilot sites in Coimbra. Each contains time-resolved in-situ temperature, pH, dissolved oxygen, electrical conductivity and oxidation–reduction potential alongside multichannel spectroscopic wavelength responses. The description explicitly states real operational conditions and use in comparative analysis and advanced modelling. Three CSV files correspond to the deployments. The related DBPFinder study also concerns Coimbra, but metadata do not prove these are its calibration inputs or identify the same network assets. Site names, sampling interval, exact wavelength channels and observation dates are not provided. The source authors provide these water-quality study data; geographic coverage is three pilot sites in Coimbra, Portugal. The deposit lists publicly accessible files under CC BY 4.0. Only descriptive metadata and file descriptors were inspected. Data values, archives, images and linked article or poster bodies remain unread. The reported treatment subject establishes the resource role, while measurement quality, independent sample counts and overlap with related experiments remain unverified.
